mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings declines and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both below their 3-month moving averages) does not predict negative returns: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates a weakening supply chain, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%), a slowdown in GDP growth (annual growth < 1.5%) signals an impending economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods of late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.0%), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% annually signals inflationary pressures, which typically lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.0% (annualized).

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates strong economic activity, which typically supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0.
